Please do not walk the land; gates and cameras secure every entrance.

description:
New Construction. 15 Zaccheus Mead Lane stands as a masterfully reimagined historic property, the original site of the c.1850 manor house of Zaccheus Mead Jr. Perched on a hill within Greenwich's prestigious Rock Ridge neighborhood, this 7,400 sq. ft. residence underwent a complete architectural top to bottom reconstruction in 2026 by The Franco Group and Dodaro Architects. The property seamlessly pairs its historic lineage with beautiful design and top-of-the-line mechanical systems just minutes from Greenwich Avenue.

Striking shingle roof accented by custom copper gutters, extensive stonework, a massive stone chimney, and an elegant stone-arched port-cochere. Professionally designed grounds by GroPro featuring a premium Summer Rain irrigation system, custom architectural lighting, a pool with water features, an outdoor kitchen, a separate hidden patio with firepit and beautiful gardens. There is also a generator.

The grand foyer features a striking glass, oak, and brass staircase, 12-foot oak-beamed ceilings, and diamond-pattern marble flooring. The great room highlights custom-paneled 9-foot ceilings, oak feature walls, a contemporary limestone fireplace with a honed stone floating hearth, an integrated Frame TV, and custom 11-foot credenza and bar with custom brass inlay, stone tops and overhead brass and glass shelving. The Epicurean Kitchen features a custom chef's space equipped with a massive center island, top-tier appliances, dual dishwashers, a microwave drawer, a walk-in pantry, and an adjacent oak-paneled sunlit breakfast room overlooking the pool and gardens. A high-gloss lacquered custom library, a powder room with a carved marble sink, a sun-drenched sunroom, a mudroom, and access to the three-stop elevator.

The home has 6 ensuite bedrooms. The primary suite sanctuary includes a vaulted coffered ceiling, a private patio, dual California Closets, and a Zen-inspired bathroom complete with radiant heated floors and a deep soaking tub and matching vessel sinks. Also on the upper level are three additional ensuite bedrooms, including two with views of the grounds and access to a large Ipe roof deck. A separate guest/versatile suite is located above the garage featuring its own coffee bar and a large multi-purpose room. There also is a lower-level ensuite bedroom ideal for family, guests or staff.

The lower-level, an entertainment & wellness haven with an expansive walk-out footprint with full-sized windows and airy 8.5-foot ceilings. The wellness center is a state-of-the-art home gym equipped with a custom 5-person sauna and a cold plunge soaking tub. A large media room with a giant TV and full surround sound, a billiard area featuring a custom, temperature-controlled wine wall, a dedicated wet bar, and a full bathroom serving both the lower level and pool area.

description:
Designed by award-winning Paul Stephan Marchese & Associates and built by highly regarded Hobbs, Inc., this exceptional custom Georgian Colonial is beautifully sited on 14 glorious acres just two miles from Greenwich Avenue. A true compound, the property includes the magnificent custom main residence, a stone pool house, a stone two-bedroom cottage with kitchen, a one-bedroom cottage with kitchen, the original George C. Scott stables, and a tennis court--all surrounded by expansive lawns and mature landscaping offering remarkable privacy. The main residence unfolds across four beautifully appointed levels serviced by an elevator, with five bedrooms, seven full and one half bathrooms, and six fireplaces. A dramatic entrance foyer sets the tone with an elegant floating staircase and inlaid checkerboard marble floors. Graciously proportioned rooms are equally suited to sophisticated entertaining and comfortable everyday living, including an elegant living room, spacious formal dining room, handsome billiards room, and richly paneled library with floor-to-ceiling bookcases all with fireplaces. A memorable George C. Scott knotty-pine bar room lends a distinctive sense of history and character to the home.
At the heart of the residence is an extraordinary gourmet kitchen centered around a 12-foot island and complemented by a generous butler's pantry. The kitchen opens to a spectacular two-story family room and separate breakfast area, where soaring floor-to-ceiling windows capture views across the magnificent grounds and flood the interiors with natural light.
The luxurious primary suite is a private retreat of exceptional scale, distinguished by a handsome tray ceiling and thoughtfully designed with two separate dressing rooms and two private bathrooms, providing beautifully appointed individual spaces and an uncommon level of comfort and privacy. There are four additional ensuite bedrooms on this level. 
Outdoors, the estate is equally impressive. Sweeping lawns and mature landscaping surround the swimming pool and spa, accompanied by a substantial stone pool house with both indoor and outdoor fireplaces--creating an exceptional setting for entertaining and relaxed country living. A handsome two-bedroom stone cottage marks the entrance to the estate, coming into view just beyond the wrought-iron gates and creating an enchanting first impression. The historic stables are tucked discreetly away, with charming one-bedroom groom's quarters nearby. Completing this picturesque enclave, the tennis court is thoughtfully and privately sited within the grounds, preserving the estate's sense of tranquility and understated elegance.
Grand in scale yet warm and inviting, this distinguished Greenwich compound brings together timeless Georgian architecture, superb craftsmanship, extraordinary acreage and an exceptional collection of accessory structures--all within two miles of Greenwich Avenue.
